notes: Hand-picked birds of KwaZulu-Natal and Zululand that the South Africa trip does not have: iSimangaliso (St Lucia, Cape Vidal), Mkuze, Phinda, Ndumo and Tembe sand forest and pans, Hluhluwe-iMfolozi, coastal and dune forest, Mtunzini and the palms, Durban gardens and the midlands forests, plus the waders, terns and herons of the Indian Ocean estuaries. Picked from the country's species with GBIF/eBird counts (za/occurrence.csv) as a ranking signal plus birding knowledge; vagrants, pelagics and birds that need a special trip are out. Left out to avoid a double listing with other packs: Pel's Fishing-Owl (pefowl1) and Mouse-coloured Sunbird (mocsun2) sit in ZA-LOWVELD; the pack ZA-GARDENROUTE holds nartro1, grbtwi1, tamdov1, lemdov2, brsrob1, whsrob1, btweye1, afcfly1, yetwow1, olibus1, cstdro1, afecuc1, blkcus1, grycus1, oliwoo2, afwowl1, crheag1, forwea1, spewea1, soutch1, afywhe4, mouwag1, hackin1, mankin2 (several of these are just as much KwaZulu-Natal birds, e.g. Narina Trogon, Tambourine Dove, Green-backed Twinspot, Mangrove and Half-collared Kingfisher, Spectacled and Dark-backed Weaver), so move them here if the Garden Route pack drops them. Left out for lack of usable photos or for doubt: African Cuckoo-Hawk (afrcuh1, photos full of look-alike hawks), Shelley's Francolin (shefra1, mixed photos), Lesser Moorhen (lesmoo1, a rare nomad in the south and photos mixed with Common Moorhen). African Pitta is not in the species list of South Africa in the database, so it cannot be added. Photos are picks from contact sheets of the unreviewed library, not approved on production: do not re-run trip_prep_media for ZA-NATAL.
